translation_snapshot.source:
Deliver a devastating axe kick dealing %d%% damage. If the blow connects your target is brain damaged, causing all talents to fail for %d turns and earning 2 combo points.
		This effect cannot be saved against, though it can be dodged and checks confusion immunity.
translation_snapshot.target:
施展一次毁灭性的踢技，造成 %d%% 伤害。如果攻击命中，对方的大脑受到伤害，不能使用技能，持续 %d 回合，同时你获得 2 连击点。
		该效果无法通过豁免抵抗，但可以被闪避，并会检查混乱免疫。

translation_snapshot.source: You require less stamina to use this talent.
translation_snapshot.target: 使用这个技能需当前体力更低。

translation_snapshot.source:
You fire a special magnetic shot with your steamgun(s) at a target for normal weapon damage.
		The shot will magnetise the target for %d turns. This lowers their defense and increases fatigue by %d.
		This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo.
		Effect strength scales with Steampower.
translation_snapshot.target:
你用蒸汽枪向目标发射特殊磁化弹，造成正常武器伤害。
子弹会使目标磁化 %d 回合，闪避降低、疲劳增加，变化量均为 %d 点。
这个技能本身就是弹药，因此不消耗弹药。
效果强度随蒸汽强度提高。

translation_snapshot.source: Ultimate talents you may only know one.
translation_snapshot.target: 终极觉醒技，你只能习得两个。

translation_snapshot.source: Moving builds up a stacking movement speed (caps at 25%) and damage bonus (caps at double). Hitting removes the bonus.
translation_snapshot.target: 移动会叠加移动速度加成（最高 25%）和伤害加成（最高使伤害翻倍）。进行近战攻击后加成消失。
